Deparment of Library & Information Services UNIVERSITY OF NAIROBI # Our Products Library Information Products The Library core mandate is to provide quality information services that will empower the University in carrying out its core activities of teaching, learning, and research and community services/consultancy. The library has therefore acquired the following various information products to support the university core activities: 1. Print Books of 243,737 Titles totaling to 423,991 Volumes. The bibliographic details of the books can be accessed through the Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) using this link:  http://library.uonbi.ac.ke/iguana/www.main.cls?surl=Ml. The print books are multi-disciplinary covering the following subject area: Law, Humanities and Social Sciences, Business, Applied and Physical Sciences and Education and serves all Campuses, Schools, Colleges and Institutes. 2. Electronic Books and Journals that include both subscribed and open access electronic information resources. The number of Copies is as follows; * 254,611 Subscribed electronic  journals and Rooks * Over 104,800 UoN Digital Repository Resources * 1,182,849 Open Access Books and Journals The electronic resources are also multi-disciplinary in nature, covering the following subject: Law, Humanities and Social Sciences, Business, Applied and Physical Sciences and Education among others. The following is the link to the publications: * Electronic Journals: https://uonlibrary.uonbi.ac.ke/electronic-journals * Electronic Books: https://uonlibrary.uonbi.ac.ke/electronic-books * Digital Repository: http://erepository.uonbi.ac.ke/ * Open Access Books, Journals and data sets: https://uonlibrary.uonbi.ac.ke/basic-page/open-access-resources and https://uonlibrary.uonbi.ac.ke/basic-page/open-data-sources 3. Local Research Publications uploaded in the University Digital Repository include Journal Publications, Conference Proceedings/Presentations, Books/Book Chapters, theses and dissertations among others covering the year from 1970s to date. The content is over 104,800 documents. The following is the link to the publications:  http://erepository.uonbi.ac.ke/ 4. Deparment of Library & Information Services UNIVERSITY OF NAIROBI # Library Guides & Presentations The University of Nairobi Library provides access to both print and electronic information resources to support the teaching, learning, and research programs of the University. The Library has a web-based Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) to facilitate the browsing of library print materials from anywhere. In addition, the Library facilitates access to electronic books (e-books) and electronic journals (e-journals) in all subject areas. Below are step-by-step instructions on how to access these, and other resources available on the library website. Deparment of Library & Information Services UNIVERSITY OF NAIROBI ## Library Services # Systems to Support Access Systems to enhance access to information resources The Library has put the following systems in place to enhance access to information resources; * The physical libraries available in faculties, schools & campuses * Remote access services that include VPN & MyLoft systems * Interactive and user friendly library website * Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) and online guide to archival information resources. * WI-FI in all libraries and within the university premises * Discovery tools that bring together all the relevant information resources in one platform using a single search box rather than searching individual databases. * Research analytical tools to enhance academic integrity and scholarly research * University Digital Repository that captures university local research * Online library user registration  * Online helpdesk & feedback system  * Online how-to-videos, guides & presentations  * Customer care and reference librarians to support feedback system and personalized services including literature searching services -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Library Fact File | Deparment of Library & Information Services (https://uonlibrary.uonbi.ac.ke/basic-page/library-fact-file) 【turn278search11】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: last month; She expressed her happiness and satisfaction with the curriculum at Egerton University and its potential impact on the country's Gender policy and documentation.
